name: Piercing Breath Weapon [Breath]
body:
Your elemental bond is strong enough to pierce any protection.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait.

Benefit(s): Your breath weapon ignores an amount of energy resistance or damage resistance equal to 1/2 your character level + your Constitution modifier (minimum 1). At 12th level, you treat immunity to the element of your breath weapon as resist 20, although this feat does not allow you to ignore that resistance.
